stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在IBM Heron 超導量子處理器案例中比較transmon 能階與Heron 耦合圖，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate transmon levels and heron coupling graph within the IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor case.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對transmon 能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for transmon levels.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識transmon 能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify transmon levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
steps.check: 提交transmon 能階的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for transmon levels.

knowledge.title: 超導電路與非諧性
knowledge.text: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 本課架構對應：transmon 能階
knowledge.textEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Course architecture correspondence: Transmon levels

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 30 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0010 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^30=0.970431。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 30 independent events with equal p=0.0010: no-error probability (1−p)^30=0.970431. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

quiz.question: 就transmon 能階的「超導電路與非諧性」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for superconducting circuits and anharmonicity in transmon levels?
options: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。
所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels.
Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
quiz.explanationEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對transmon 能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for transmon levels.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「超導電路與非諧性」模型，檢查transmon 能階的兩個假想案例。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving transmon levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
steps.check: 提交transmon 能階的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for transmon levels.

steps.title: 耦合圖與路由：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Coupling graphs and routing: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Heron 耦合圖提出可反駁的耦合圖與路由模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable coupling graphs and routing model and evidence record for heron coupling graph.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Heron 耦合圖。原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。 建立耦合圖與路由的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify heron coupling graph in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。
steps.observationEn: Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：物理位元數相同就代表相同電路成本。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal physical-qubit counts imply equal circuit costs.
steps.check: 提交Heron 耦合圖的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for heron coupling graph.

steps.title: 微波控制與串擾：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Microwave control and crosstalk: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對微波控制線提出可反駁的微波控制與串擾模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable microwave control and crosstalk model and evidence record for microwave control lines.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識微波控制線。控制脈衝的頻譜可同時激發鄰近模態；閘錯誤不只是振幅偏差。 建立微波控制與串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify microwave control lines in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Control spectra can excite neighboring modes; gate error is not only amplitude error. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microwave control and crosstalk, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。
steps.observationEn: Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：單獨量到的閘精度可直接代表同時操作精度。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Isolated gate fidelity directly equals simultaneous-operation fidelity.
steps.check: 提交微波控制線的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instructionEn: Identify multistage heat paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cryogenic heat paths and signal loads, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.titleEn: Error correction and logical evidence: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對邏輯錯誤證據提出可反駁的錯誤更正與邏輯證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable error correction and logical evidence model and evidence record for logical-error evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識邏輯錯誤證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify logical-error evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.text: 假設 30 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0010 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^30=0.970431。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 30 independent events with equal p=0.0010: no-error probability (1−p)^30=0.970431. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

steps.objective: 針對冷卻與訊號預算提出可反駁的低溫熱路與訊號負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable cryogenic heat paths and signal loads model and evidence record for cooling and signal budgets.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「低溫熱路與訊號負載」模型，檢查冷卻與訊號預算的兩個假想案例。建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous cryogenic heat paths and signal loads model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving cooling and signal budgets. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。
steps.observationEn: Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cooling and signal budgets.

steps.title: 錯誤更正與邏輯證據：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Error correction and logical evidence: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對跨碼距閾值比較提出可反駁的錯誤更正與邏輯證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable error correction and logical evidence model and evidence record for cross-distance threshold comparison.
steps.instruction: 在「Google Willow 表面碼系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨碼距閾值比較。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify cross-distance threshold comparison in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google Willow surface-code system. Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。
steps.observationEn: Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加物理位元必然降低邏輯錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More physical qubits necessarily reduce logical error.
steps.check: 提交跨碼距閾值比較的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cross-distance threshold comparison.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 33 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0011 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^33=0.964332。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 33 independent events with equal p=0.0011: no-error probability (1−p)^33=0.964332. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

courses.summary: 以碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標解析Google Willow 表面碼系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore Google Willow surface-code system through code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。 特定表面碼記憶實驗的閾值以下結果，不等同完整容錯通用電腦或任意工作負載上的量子優勢。
courses.scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct. Below-threshold results from particular surface-code memory experiments do not establish a complete fault-tolerant universal computer or advantage on arbitrary workloads.

steps.instruction: 在「Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Ankaa 接面與能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Identify thermalization and shielding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cryogenic heat paths and signal loads, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.titleEn: Error correction and logical evidence: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對閘誤差與邏輯證據提出可反駁的錯誤更正與邏輯證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable error correction and logical evidence model and evidence record for gate errors and logical evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識閘誤差與邏輯證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gate errors and logical evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。
steps.observationEn: Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加物理位元必然降低邏輯錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More physical qubits necessarily reduce logical error.
steps.check: 提交閘誤差與邏輯證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 36 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0012 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^36=0.957695。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 36 independent events with equal p=0.0012: no-error probability (1−p)^36=0.957695. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

courses.summaryEn: Explore Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture through square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

steps.title: 離子陷阱與模態：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Ion traps and modes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Yb離子與集體模態提出可反駁的離子陷阱與模態模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ion traps and modes model and evidence record for yb ions and collective modes.
steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Yb離子與集體模態。電場侷限帶電離子；集體運動模態提供部分糾纏閘的中介。 建立離子陷阱與模態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。區分內部態、運動模態及環境噪聲三個子系統。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify yb ions and collective modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Electric fields confine charged ions; collective motion mediates some entangling gates. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion traps and modes, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 區分內部態、運動模態及環境噪聲三個子系統。
steps.observationEn: Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：離子內部態與運動模態是同一個變數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Internal states and motional modes are the same variable.
steps.check: 提交Yb離子與集體模態的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for yb ions and collective modes.

steps.objective: 針對光學地址與通道提出可反駁的雷射位址與空間串擾模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable laser addressing and spatial crosstalk model and evidence record for optical addressing and channels.
steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識光學地址與通道。光束位址將控制侷限到目標離子，但光學旁瓣及漂移可影響鄰近離子。 建立雷射位址與空間串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用位址矩陣比較目標響應與非目標響應。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify optical addressing and channels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Beam addressing localizes control, but sidelobes and drift can affect neighbors. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of laser addressing and spatial crosstalk, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare intended and unintended responses in an addressing matrix. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 運動介導的糾纏：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Motion-mediated entanglement: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對運動介導雙位元閘提出可反駁的運動介導的糾纏模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable motion-mediated entanglement model and evidence record for motion-mediated gates.
steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識運動介導雙位元閘。兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。 建立運動介導的糾纏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of motion-mediated entanglement, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. knowledge.title: 運動介導的糾纏
knowledge.text: 兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。 本課架構對應：運動介導雙位元閘
knowledge.textEn: Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information. Course architecture correspondence: Motion-mediated gates

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；只要任意時刻有糾纏就代表閘完成。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Entanglement at any intermediate time proves a completed gate.

quiz.question: 就運動介導雙位元閘的「運動介導的糾纏」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for motion-mediated entanglement in motion-mediated gates?
options: 只要任意時刻有糾纏就代表閘完成。
兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Entanglement at any intermediate time proves a completed gate.
Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。 比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。
quiz.explanationEn: Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths.

steps.title: 運動介導的糾纏：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Motion-mediated entanglement: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對運動介導雙位元閘提出可反駁的運動介導的糾纏模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable motion-mediated entanglement model and evidence record for motion-mediated gates.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「運動介導的糾纏」模型，檢查運動介導雙位元閘的兩個假想案例。比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous motion-mediated entanglement model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving motion-mediated gates. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。
steps.observationEn: Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要任意時刻有糾纏就代表閘完成。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Entanglement at any intermediate time proves a completed gate.
steps.check: 提交運動介導雙位元閘的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for motion-mediated gates.

steps.title: 連通性與排程：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Connectivity and scheduling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對運算區排程提出可反駁的連通性與排程模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable connectivity and scheduling model and evidence record for gate-zone scheduling.
steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識運算區排程。邏輯全連通不保證所有閘能同時執行；光學通道與模態共享形成排程限制。 建立連通性與排程的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同閘集合比較串行及資源受限排程。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gate-zone scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Logical all-to-all connectivity does not imply unlimited parallel gates; shared optical channels and modes constrain scheduling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of connectivity and scheduling, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對相同閘集合比較串行及資源受限排程。
steps.observationEn: Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：全連通等同零延遲及無限並行。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All-to-all connectivity means zero latency and unlimited parallelism.
steps.check: 提交運算區排程的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gate-zone scheduling.

steps.title: 離子搬運與分區：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Ion transport and zoning: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對跑道QCCD搬運提出可反駁的離子搬運與分區模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ion transport and zoning model and evidence record for racetrack qccd transport.
steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跑道QCCD搬運。QCCD 以搬運及分區連接運算區；重排時間與加熱需納入總電路成本。 建立離子搬運與分區的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫兩區搬運圖並分開閘時間、搬運及冷卻。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify racetrack qccd transport in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. QCCD connects zones by transport; rearrangement time and heating contribute to circuit cost. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion transport and zoning, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw a two-zone transport graph and separate gates, transport and cooling. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫兩區搬運圖並分開閘時間、搬運及冷卻。
steps.observationEn: Draw a two-zone transport graph and separate gates, transport and cooling.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：離子搬運時間可一律略過。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Ion transport time can always be ignored.
steps.check: 提交跑道QCCD搬運的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 螢光讀出與重用：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Fluorescence readout and reuse: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對中途螢光量測提出可反駁的螢光讀出與重用模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable fluorescence readout and reuse model and evidence record for mid-circuit fluorescence.
steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識中途螢光量測。讀出由散射光子統計決定；重置、旁觀者位元及量測時間影響中途量測。 建立螢光讀出與重用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mid-circuit fluorescence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. steps.title: 線性鏈與QCCD比較：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Linear chains versus QCCD: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對重排與通道邊界提出可反駁的線性鏈與QCCD比較模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable linear chains versus qccd model and evidence record for rearrangement and channel boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「IonQ Forte 光學位址量子核心」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識重排與通道邊界。Forte公開架構重點為光學可設定離子鏈；QCCD搬運是可比較的另一架構，不宣稱Forte實作跑道QCCD。 建立線性鏈與QCCD比較的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是聲光偏轉選址與線性離子鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。並排比較位址重設與離子搬運，標出各自公開支持的功能。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 在「QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多體空間關聯。關聯量依多次樣本估計；空間結構與有限樣本偏差需同時檢查。 建立關聯函數與有限樣本的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Correlations are estimated from repeated shots; spatial structure and finite-sample bias both matter. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of correlators and finite samples, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Identify fresnel optical register in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Pasqal Fresnel optical-tweezer QPU. Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of optical-tweezer arrays and loading, focusing on device constraints, atom layouts and pulse validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for fresnel optical register.

steps.objective: 針對有限樣本關聯函數提出可反駁的關聯函數與有限樣本模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識有限樣本關聯函數。關聯量依多次樣本估計；空間結構與有限樣本偏差需同時檢查。 建立關聯函數與有限樣本的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 在「Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識擠壓態與PNR條件資源。Aurora使用擠壓光學資源與PNR条件量測產生非高斯資源；不能直接等同PsiQuantum的單光子來源路線。 建立擠壓態與條件資源的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫高斯來源、條件事件與資源供應的層次，分開機率與光路損耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify squeezed states/pnr-heralded resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system. PNR counting supports heralding/multiplexing, while homodyne observes optical quadratures; they are different observables. stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate single-photon encoding and probabilistic sources and multiplexing within the PsiQuantum Omega fusion-based photonic architecture case.

steps.title: 光子編碼與模式：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Photonic encoding and modes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對單光子編碼提出可反駁的光子編碼與模式模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable photonic encoding and modes model and evidence record for single-photon encoding.
steps.instruction: 在「PsiQuantum Omega 融合式光子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識單光子編碼。路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。 建立光子編碼與模式的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify single-photon encoding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for PsiQuantum Omega fusion-based photonic architecture. Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of photonic encoding and modes, focusing on sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Map encodings, modes and measurements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。
steps.observationEn: Map encodings, modes and measurements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.
steps.check: 提交單光子編碼的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for single-photon encoding.

knowledge.title: 光子編碼與模式
knowledge.text: 路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。 本課架構對應：單光子編碼
knowledge.textEn: Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts. Course architecture correspondence: Single-photon encoding

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Map encodings, modes and measurements. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 4 段光路各透過率 0.88，獨立串接成功率為 0.88^4=0.599695；總損耗 2.2207 dB。未含光源、偵測器及糾纏閘失敗，不能當作容錯閾值。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 4 segments each transmit 0.88: cascaded success 0.88^4=0.599695, loss 2.2207 dB. Sources, detectors and entangling-gate failure are excluded; this is not a fault-tolerance threshold.

quiz.question: 就單光子編碼的「光子編碼與模式」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for photonic encoding and modes in single-photon encoding?
options: 路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。
所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts.
Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。 畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。
quiz.explanationEn: Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts. Map encodings, modes and measurements.

steps.title: 光子編碼與模式：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Photonic encoding and modes: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對單光子編碼提出可反駁的光子編碼與模式模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable photonic encoding and modes model and evidence record for single-photon encoding.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「光子編碼與模式」模型，檢查單光子編碼的兩個假想案例。畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous photonic encoding and modes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving single-photon encoding. Map encodings, modes and measurements. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Map encodings, modes and measurements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.
steps.check: 提交單光子編碼的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for single-photon encoding.

steps.title: 單光子源與多工：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Photon sources and multiplexing: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對機率性來源與多工提出可反駁的單光子源與多工模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable photon sources and multiplexing model and evidence record for probabilistic sources and multiplexing.
steps.instruction: 在「PsiQuantum Omega 融合式光子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識機率性來源與多工。機率性光源可用多工增加供應率，但損耗、延遲及開關成本仍存在。 建立單光子源與多工的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由假想獨立光源機率計算至少一個成功率。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify probabilistic sources and multiplexing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for PsiQuantum Omega fusion-based photonic architecture. Multiplexing improves probabilistic supply, with remaining loss, delay and switching costs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of photon sources and multiplexing, focusing on sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute at-least-one success from assumed independent sources. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 由假想獨立光源機率計算至少一個成功率。
steps.observationEn: Compute at-least-one success from assumed independent sources.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：多工同時使光源確定且沒有損耗。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Multiplexing makes sources deterministic without loss.
steps.check: 提交機率性來源與多工的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for probabilistic sources and multiplexing.

steps.title: 光路損耗與可用率：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Optical loss and availability: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對封裝與光纖損耗提出可反駁的光路損耗與可用率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable optical loss and availability model and evidence record for package and fiber loss.
steps.instruction: 在「PsiQuantum Omega 融合式光子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識封裝與光纖損耗。串接光學元件的透過率相乘；插入損耗會降低偵測及糾纏資源供應。 建立光路損耗與可用率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把逐段 dB 損耗轉成線性成功率後交叉核對。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify package and fiber loss in the mentor diagram and primary sources for PsiQuantum Omega fusion-based photonic architecture. Cascaded transmission multiplies; insertion loss reduces detection and entangled-resource supply. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of optical loss and availability, focusing on sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Convert segment dB losses to linear success and cross-check. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把逐段 dB 損耗轉成線性成功率後交叉核對。
steps.observationEn: Convert segment dB losses to linear success and cross-check.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：10% 的每段損耗可以直接從100%相減任意次。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Repeated ten-percent losses can be subtracted linearly from 100%.
steps.check: 提交封裝與光纖損耗的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instructionEn: Identify gate-defined dots in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip. Gates define confinement/charge; electron spin supplies a degree of freedom distinct from position. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of quantum dots and spin subspaces, focusing on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 自旋控制與共振：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Spin control and resonance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對自旋共振選擇提出可反駁的自旋控制與共振模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable spin control and resonance model and evidence record for spin-resonance selectivity.

steps.instructionEn: Identify spin-resonance selectivity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip. Splitting defines resonance scales; drift and neighboring frequencies limit selectivity. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of spin control and resonance, focusing on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare resolvability of two assumed frequency distributions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 自旋控制與共振：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Spin control and resonance: evidence validation

Compare resolvability of two assumed frequency distributions. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instructionEn: Identify spin-to-charge readout in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip. Some readout maps spin information to charge events, requiring separate conversion and sensing error budgets. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of spin-to-charge readout, focusing on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare a two-layer confusion model with a one-layer approximation. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識QUBO與Ising符號。二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。 建立Ising 與 QUBO 對映的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QUBO、Zephyr 圖嵌入與端到端公平比較。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ising and qubo mapping, focusing on qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識InAs–Al近接結構。半導體與超導體的近接結構可能產生不同低能態；材料設計本身不是拓撲證據。 建立近接材料與能隙的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是近接材料、奇偶讀出及拓撲宣稱審查。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列出拓撲與平庸模型都能解釋的觀測。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Proximity heterostructures can host different low-energy states; material design alone is not topological evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of proximity materials and gaps, focusing on proximity materials, parity readout and review of topological claims. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List observations compatible with both topological and trivial models. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Assume 1000 readouts with 500 per label and 5/10 misassignments: class errors 1%/2%, balanced error 1.5%. This quantifies assumed readout only, not topology, non-Abelian operations or protected logical qubits.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在ResNet 殘差視覺網路案例中比較卷積stem與shape與F(x)+x殘差連接，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate convolutional stem and shapes and f(x)+x residual connection within the ResNet residual vision network case.

steps.title: 殘差映射與恆等路徑：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Residual maps and identity paths: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對卷積stem與shape提出可反駁的殘差映射與恆等路徑模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual maps and identity paths model and evidence record for convolutional stem and shapes.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識卷積stem與shape。殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 建立殘差映射與恆等路徑的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify convolutional stem and shapes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual maps and identity paths, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。
steps.observationEn: Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.
steps.check: 提交卷積stem與shape的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for convolutional stem and shapes.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(64x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 196608 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 26624 bytes, intensity 7.3846 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition.

Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.objective: 針對卷積stem與shape提出可反駁的殘差映射與恆等路徑模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous residual maps and identity paths model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving convolutional stem and shapes. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.
steps.check: 提交卷積stem與shape的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for convolutional stem and shapes.

steps.titleEn: Convolutional receptive field and resolution: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對F(x)+x殘差連接提出可反駁的卷積感受野與解析度模型與驗證紀錄。

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate cross-layer gradient paths and feature-map memory within the ResNet residual vision network case.

steps.title: 殘差雅可比與梯度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Residual Jacobians and gradients: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對跨層梯度路徑提出可反駁的殘差雅可比與梯度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual jacobians and gradients model and evidence record for cross-layer gradient paths.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨層梯度路徑。等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。 建立殘差雅可比與梯度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify cross-layer gradient paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual jacobians and gradients, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。
steps.observationEn: Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：存在恆等跳接就消除全部梯度問題。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An identity skip eliminates every gradient problem.
steps.check: 提交跨層梯度路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cross-layer gradient paths.

knowledge.title: 殘差雅可比與梯度
knowledge.text: 等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。 本課架構對應：跨層梯度路徑
knowledge.textEn: A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction. Course architecture correspondence: Cross-layer gradient paths

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；存在恆等跳接就消除全部梯度問題。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: An identity skip eliminates every gradient problem.

quiz.question: 就跨層梯度路徑的「殘差雅可比與梯度」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for residual jacobians and gradients in cross-layer gradient paths?
options: 存在恆等跳接就消除全部梯度問題。
等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: An identity skip eliminates every gradient problem.
A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。 以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。
quiz.explanationEn: A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction. Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices.

steps.title: 殘差雅可比與梯度：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual Jacobians and gradients: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對跨層梯度路徑提出可反駁的殘差雅可比與梯度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual jacobians and gradients model and evidence record for cross-layer gradient paths.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「殘差雅可比與梯度」模型，檢查跨層梯度路徑的兩個假想案例。以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous residual jacobians and gradients model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving cross-layer gradient paths. Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。
steps.observationEn: Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：存在恆等跳接就消除全部梯度問題。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An identity skip eliminates every gradient problem.
steps.check: 提交跨層梯度路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cross-layer gradient paths.

steps.title: 運算量與記憶體：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Compute and memory: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對feature map記憶提出可反駁的運算量與記憶體模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable compute and memory model and evidence record for feature-map memory.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識feature map記憶。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify feature-map memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for feature-map memory.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate grouped splits and leakage and class and transfer failures within the ResNet residual vision network case.

steps.title: 資料切分與洩漏：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Data splits and leakage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對羣組分割與資料洩漏提出可反駁的資料切分與洩漏模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable data splits and leakage model and evidence record for grouped splits and leakage.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識羣組分割與資料洩漏。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify grouped splits and leakage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測試資料參加調參仍可當獨立測試。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.
steps.check: 提交羣組分割與資料洩漏的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for grouped splits and leakage.

knowledge.textEn: Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.

quiz.question: 就羣組分割與資料洩漏的「資料切分與洩漏」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for data splits and leakage in grouped splits and leakage?
options: 用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。
測試資料參加調參仍可當獨立測試。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.
Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.

steps.title: 失效分析與泛化：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Failure analysis and generalization: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對類別與移轉失效提出可反駁的失效分析與泛化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for class and transfer failures.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識類別與移轉失效。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify class and transfer failures in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.
steps.check: 提交類別與移轉失效的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for class and transfer failures.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。

steps.title: 失效分析與泛化：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Failure analysis and generalization: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對類別與移轉失效提出可反駁的失效分析與泛化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for class and transfer failures.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「失效分析與泛化」模型，檢查類別與移轉失效的兩個假想案例。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous failure analysis and generalization model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving class and transfer failures. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.

steps.title: 縮放點積注意力：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Scaled dot-product attention: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對token與位置張量提出可反駁的縮放點積注意力模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scaled dot-product attention model and evidence record for token and position tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識token與位置張量。QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。 建立縮放點積注意力的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify token and position tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scaled dot-product attention, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Attention weights are a fixed average over every token.

steps.instruction: 在「U-Net 多尺度分割網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Dice與小目標誤差。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.title: 圖鄰域遮罩：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對節點與邊張量提出可反駁的圖鄰域遮罩模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable graph-neighborhood masks model and evidence record for node and edge tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識節點與邊張量。GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。 建立圖鄰域遮罩的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify node and edge tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of graph-neighborhood masks, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。
steps.observationEn: List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個GAT節點都必然能看見所有節點。

steps.check: 提交節點與邊張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for node and edge tensors.

steps.instruction: 在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識聚合與梯度路徑。跨未見圖泛化與同圖未標籤節點预测不同；圖建構本身也可能洩漏標籤。 建立歸納式與轉導式證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開兩種測試邊界並審查建邊資訊來源。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for degree bias and interpretation.
steps.instruction: 在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識度數偏差與解釋。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify degree bias and interpretation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.
steps.check: 提交度數偏差與解釋的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for degree bias and interpretation.

knowledge.title: 失效分析與泛化
knowledge.text: 平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 本課架構對應：度數偏差與解釋
knowledge.textEn: Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Course architecture correspondence: Degree bias and interpretation

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；高confidence就足以認定答案正確。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(112×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=344064 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=41984 byte，算術強度=8.1951 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(112x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 344064 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 41984 bytes, intensity 8.1951 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就度數偏差與解釋的「失效分析與泛化」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for failure analysis and generalization in degree bias and interpretation?
options: 高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: High confidence establishes correctness.
Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
quiz.explanationEn: Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.

steps.title: 失效分析與泛化：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Failure analysis and generalization: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對度數偏差與解釋提出可反駁的失效分析與泛化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for degree bias and interpretation.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「失效分析與泛化」模型，檢查度數偏差與解釋的兩個假想案例。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous failure analysis and generalization model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving degree bias and interpretation. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.
steps.check: 提交度數偏差與解釋的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for degree bias and interpretation.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate inputs and expert tensors and top-k gated routing within the Sparse mixture-of-experts network case.

steps.titleEn: Gating and sparse experts: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對輸入與專家張量提出可反駁的閘控與稀疏專家模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gating and sparse experts model and evidence record for inputs and expert tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識輸入與專家張量。router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 建立閘控與稀疏專家的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify inputs and expert tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gating and sparse experts, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inputs and expert tensors.

steps.title: 容量與路由負載：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Capacity and routing load: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對top-k門控route提出可反駁的容量與路由負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable capacity and routing load model and evidence record for top-k gated routing.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識top-k門控route。專家容量限制可能丟棄或重路由token；相同平均負載不表示無局部overflow。 建立容量與路由負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify top-k gated routing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Expert capacity can drop/reroute tokens; equal mean load does not imply no local overflow. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of capacity and routing load, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。
steps.observationEn: Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：平均token量低於容量就排除所有專家超載。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Mean token load below capacity rules out every expert overload.
steps.check: 提交top-k門控route的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

knowledge.text: 將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；平均token量低於容量就排除所有專家超載。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Mean token load below capacity rules out every expert overload.

quiz.question: 就top-k門控route的「容量與路由負載」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for capacity and routing load in top-k gated routing?
options: 平均token量低於容量就排除所有專家超載。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
專家容量限制可能丟棄或重路由token；相同平均負載不表示無局部overflow。
optionsEn: Mean token load below capacity rules out every expert overload.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Expert capacity can drop/reroute tokens; equal mean load does not imply no local overflow.
quiz.explanation: 專家容量限制可能丟棄或重路由token；相同平均負載不表示無局部overflow。 將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。
quiz.explanationEn: Expert capacity can drop/reroute tokens; equal mean load does not imply no local overflow. Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow.

steps.title: 容量與路由負載：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Capacity and routing load: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對top-k門控route提出可反駁的容量與路由負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable capacity and routing load model and evidence record for top-k gated routing.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「容量與路由負載」模型，檢查top-k門控route的兩個假想案例。將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分專家容量限制可能丟棄或重路由token；相同平均負載不表示無局部overflow。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous capacity and routing load model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving top-k gated routing. Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Expert capacity can drop/reroute tokens; equal mean load does not imply no local overflow." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。
steps.observationEn: Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：平均token量低於容量就排除所有專家超載。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Mean token load below capacity rules out every expert overload.
steps.check: 提交top-k門控route的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for top-k gated routing.

steps.title: 專家資料搬運：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Expert data movement: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對稀疏梯度路徑提出可反駁的專家資料搬運模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable expert data movement model and evidence record for sparse gradient paths.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識稀疏梯度路徑。分散專家需搬運token與輸出；all-to-all通信會影響端到端成本及負載平衡。 建立專家資料搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定token數比較本地與跨裝置專家路由bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sparse gradient paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Distributed experts move tokens/results; all-to-all traffic affects cost/load balance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of expert data movement, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare local/cross-device routing bytes at fixed token count. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 固定token數比較本地與跨裝置專家路由bytes。
steps.observationEn: Compare local/cross-device routing bytes at fixed token count.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：稀疏啟動表示完全沒有裝置間通信。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Sparse activation removes all interdevice communication.
steps.check: 提交稀疏梯度路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sparse gradient paths.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable compute and memory model and evidence record for activated versus total parameters.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識activated與total參數。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify activated versus total parameters in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 資料切分與洩漏：架構分析

steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識路由與來源切分。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識精度等質能量比較。利用率、傳輸與數值精度共同決定每項工作能量；額定功率不等於平均能耗。 建立能耗與工作負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of energy and workload, focusing on die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality. steps.instruction: 在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識v5p TensorCore。資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。 建立脈動矩陣與張量核的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of systolic matrices and tensorcores, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compilation and partitioning, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 晶圓網格與局部記憶：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wafer meshes and local memory: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對WSE本地core與SRAM提出可反駁的晶圓網格與局部記憶模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wafer meshes and local memory model and evidence record for wse local cores and sram.
steps.instruction: 在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識WSE本地core與SRAM。晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。 建立晶圓網格與局部記憶的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify wse local cores and sram in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wafer meshes and local memory, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Identify wafer redundancy and rerouting in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Large-area designs face defects; redundancy/rerouting create usable resources, not flawless wafers. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wafer redundancy and yield, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check connectivity/capacity after remapping an assumed defect map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在假想缺陷圖檢查重映射後的連通及容量。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：可用晶圓即表示每個物理核心都無缺陷。

steps.title: 晶圓容錯與良率：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Wafer redundancy and yield: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對晶圓冗餘繞路提出可反駁的晶圓容錯與良率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wafer redundancy and yield model and evidence record for wafer redundancy and rerouting.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「晶圓容錯與良率」模型，檢查晶圓冗餘繞路的兩個假想案例。在假想缺陷圖檢查重映射後的連通及容量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分大面積設計需面對缺陷；冗餘與繞路形成可用資源而非完美晶圓。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous wafer redundancy and yield model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving wafer redundancy and rerouting. Check connectivity/capacity after remapping an assumed defect map. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Large-area designs face defects; redundancy/rerouting create usable resources, not flawless wafers." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
