steps.observationEn: Check connectivity/capacity after remapping an assumed defect map.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：可用晶圓即表示每個物理核心都無缺陷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A usable wafer means every physical core is defect-free.
steps.check: 提交晶圓冗餘繞路的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate multi-cs system gradients and wafer/facility cooling within the Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster case.

steps.title: 叢集擴充與參數同步：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Cluster scaling and synchronization: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對多CS系統梯度提出可反駁的叢集擴充與參數同步模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable cluster scaling and synchronization model and evidence record for multi-cs system gradients.
steps.instruction: 在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多CS系統梯度。多個系統共享參數與同步梯度，擴充效率還取決於網絡和批次。 建立叢集擴充與參數同步的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定全局批次比較單系統與多系統效率。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify multi-cs system gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Systems share parameters/synchronize gradients; network and batches still limit scaling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cluster scaling and synchronization, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 固定全局批次比較單系統與多系統效率。
steps.observationEn: Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加系統必然線性加速所有模型。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Adding systems linearly speeds every model.
steps.check: 提交多CS系統梯度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for multi-cs system gradients.

steps.objective: 針對晶圓與設施散熱提出可反駁的冷卻與工作能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable cooling and job energy model and evidence record for wafer/facility cooling.
steps.instruction: 在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識晶圓與設施散熱。芯片、供電與冷卻形成不同效率層；裸芯片性能不是完整系統能效。 建立冷卻與工作能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把計算、通信與設施能量分別列表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Chip, power delivery and cooling have separate efficiencies; chip performance is not system energy efficiency. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cooling and job energy, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List compute, communication and facility energy separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：芯片指標即可取代設施能耗量測。

steps.title: 脈衝與時間編碼：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Spikes and temporal encoding: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對graded spike事件提出可反駁的脈衝與時間編碼模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable spikes and temporal encoding model and evidence record for graded-spike events.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識graded spike事件。神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。 建立脈衝與時間編碼的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify graded-spike events in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform. Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of spikes and temporal encoding, focusing on asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare rate and event-time representations for one input. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。
steps.observationEn: Compare rate and event-time representations for one input.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Spiking networks can use only fixed rate codes.
steps.check: 提交graded spike事件的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for graded-spike events.

steps.title: 脈衝與時間編碼：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Spikes and temporal encoding: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對graded spike事件提出可反駁的脈衝與時間編碼模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable spikes and temporal encoding model and evidence record for graded-spike events.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「脈衝與時間編碼」模型，檢查graded spike事件的兩個假想案例。比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous spikes and temporal encoding model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving graded-spike events. Compare rate and event-time representations for one input. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Compare rate and event-time representations for one input.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。

steps.check: 提交graded spike事件的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instruction: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識膜狀態微碼。神經元模型積累、泄漏及發放；離散時間近似需要說明步長。 建立膜電位與閾值的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。重算小型leaky積分模型與兩種步長誤差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.title: 突觸記憶與可塑性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Synaptic memory and plasticity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對local synapse與學習提出可反駁的突觸記憶與可塑性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable synaptic memory and plasticity model and evidence record for local synapses and learning.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識local synapse與學習。權重及學習規則儲存在本地狀態；在線學習與推論模式有不同數據流。 建立突觸記憶與可塑性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開權重讀、狀態寫與學習更新事件。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify local synapses and learning in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform. Local state holds weights/rules; learning and inference have different flows. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of synaptic memory and plasticity, focusing on asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate weight reads, state writes and learning updates. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare peak queues under mean/bursty event flows. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Lava端到端比較。事件驅動能耗須連同輸入編碼與結果質量比較；與密集網絡需相同任務邊界。 建立效率與公平比較的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較全流程時間、能量與準確率而非只計芯片核心。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Event-driven energy needs encoding/result-quality context; dense-network comparison needs matching task boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare end-to-end time, energy and accuracy beyond cores. steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for h100 and host-memory topology.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識H100與主記憶拓撲。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify h100 and host-memory topology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA DGX H100 eight-GPU server. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. workedExample.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.025 and 16 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=11.6364. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

courses.title: El Capitan MI300A 超級電腦

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在El Capitan MI300A 超級電腦案例中比較MI300A共享HBM與APU與Slingshot網絡，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate mi300a shared hbm and apu and slingshot fabrics within the El Capitan MI300A supercomputer case.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對MI300A共享HBM提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for mi300a shared hbm.
steps.instruction: 在「El Capitan MI300A 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MI300A共享HBM。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是APU 共享 HBM 與 Slingshot 系統架構。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mi300a shared hbm in the mentor diagram and primary sources for El Capitan MI300A supercomputer. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on apu shared hbm and slingshot systems. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交MI300A共享HBM的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mi300a shared hbm.

knowledge.title: 節點與記憶體層級

knowledge.textEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Course architecture correspondence: MI300A shared HBM

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.030，使用 24 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=14.2012。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.030 and 24 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=14.2012. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.

quiz.question: 就MI300A共享HBM的「節點與記憶體層級」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nodes and memory hierarchy in mi300a shared hbm?
options: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。
統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access.
Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
quiz.explanationEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對MI300A共享HBM提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for mi300a shared hbm.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「節點與記憶體層級」模型，檢查MI300A共享HBM的兩個假想案例。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nodes and memory hierarchy model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving mi300a shared hbm. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交MI300A共享HBM的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mi300a shared hbm.

steps.titleEn: Intranode and internode networks: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對APU與Slingshot網絡提出可反駁的節點內與節點間網路模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable intranode and internode networks model and evidence record for apu and slingshot fabrics.
steps.instruction: 在「El Capitan MI300A 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識APU與Slingshot網絡。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是APU 共享 HBM 與 Slingshot 系統架構。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify apu and slingshot fabrics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for El Capitan MI300A supercomputer. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on apu shared hbm and slingshot systems. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：節點內GPU互連規格等於跨機櫃網絡規格。

knowledge.textEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.030，使用 24 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=14.2012。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.030 and 24 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=14.2012. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.

quiz.question: 就節點排程與一致性的「排程隔離與復原」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for scheduling, isolation and recovery in node scheduling and consistency?
options: 換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.
Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
quiz.explanationEn: Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.

steps.title: 排程隔離與復原：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Scheduling, isolation and recovery: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對節點排程與一致性提出可反駁的排程隔離與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for node scheduling and consistency.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「排程隔離與復原」模型，檢查節點排程與一致性的兩個假想案例。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous scheduling, isolation and recovery model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving node scheduling and consistency. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
steps.observationEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.
steps.check: 提交節點排程與一致性的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for node scheduling and consistency.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦案例中比較GH200相干記憶與node內與Slingshot，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate gh200 coherent memory and intranode and slingshot within the Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer case.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對GH200相干記憶提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for gh200 coherent memory.
steps.instruction: 在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識GH200相干記憶。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gh200 coherent memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交GH200相干記憶的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gh200 coherent memory.

steps.objective: 針對node內與Slingshot提出可反駁的節點內與節點間網路模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識異質partition選擇。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify heterogeneous partition choice in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.
steps.check: 提交異質partition選擇的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for heterogeneous partition choice.

knowledge.textEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Course architecture correspondence: A100/EPYC topology

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.020，使用 8 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=7.0175。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.020 and 8 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=7.0175. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.

quiz.question: 就A100與EPYC拓撲的「節點與記憶體層級」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nodes and memory hierarchy in a100/epyc topology?
options: 統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
quiz.explanationEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.

steps.title: 節點內與節點間網路：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Intranode and internode networks: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Dragonfly光銅連線提出可反駁的節點內與節點間網路模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable intranode and internode networks model and evidence record for dragonfly optical/copper links.

steps.instructionEn: Identify dragonfly optical/copper links in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。
steps.observationEn: Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：節點內GPU互連規格等於跨機櫃網絡規格。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Intranode GPU rates equal interrack fabric rates.
steps.check: 提交Dragonfly光銅連線的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for dragonfly optical/copper links.

steps.instructionEn: Identify cpu/gpu partitioning in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。

steps.check: 提交CPU/GPU分工的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instruction: 在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識排程與檢查點重啟。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify scheduling/checkpoint restart in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.020，使用 8 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=7.0175。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。

courses.summary: 以雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存解析Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions through dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 公開伺服器與超算架構的離線工作流、通信、儲存及能量模型；非機櫃接線、供電施工或實體維護SOP，也不表示學員取得廠商／研究中心設備存取。
courses.scopeEn: Offline workflow, fabric, storage and energy models of public servers/HPC. No rack-wiring, power-installation or physical-maintenance SOP and no vendor/research-center hardware access is implied.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Booster GPU與主機提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for booster gpu and host.
steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Booster GPU與主機。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify booster gpu and host in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for booster gpu and host.

knowledge.title: 節點與記憶體層級

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界

knowledge.textEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.025，使用 16 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=11.6364。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.025 and 16 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=11.6364. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nodes and memory hierarchy in booster gpu and host?
options: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。
統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access.
Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Booster GPU與主機提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for booster gpu and host.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「節點與記憶體層級」模型，檢查Booster GPU與主機的兩個假想案例。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nodes and memory hierarchy model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving booster gpu and host. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交Booster GPU與主機的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 節點內與節點間網路：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Intranode and internode networks: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對InfiniBand層級提出可反駁的節點內與節點間網路模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable intranode and internode networks model and evidence record for infiniband hierarchy.
steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識InfiniBand層級。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify infiniband hierarchy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。
steps.observationEn: Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：節點內GPU互連規格等於跨機櫃網絡規格。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Intranode GPU rates equal interrack fabric rates.
steps.check: 提交InfiniBand層級的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for infiniband hierarchy.

steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨分區排程。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「排程隔離與復原」模型，檢查跨分區排程的兩個假想案例。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous scheduling, isolation and recovery model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving cross-partition scheduling. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instructionEn: Identify gh200 and cpu modules in the mentor diagram and primary sources for JUPITER modular supercomputing system. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on booster, cluster and tiered-storage cooperation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 工作分割與平行效率：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Work partition and parallel efficiency: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對模塊化工作分割提出可反駁的工作分割與平行效率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable work partition and parallel efficiency model and evidence record for modular workload partition.
steps.instruction: 在「JUPITER 模組超算系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模塊化工作分割。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是Booster、Cluster 與多層儲存協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify modular workload partition in the mentor diagram and primary sources for JUPITER modular supercomputing system. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on booster, cluster and tiered-storage cooperation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.
steps.check: 提交模塊化工作分割的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for modular workload partition.

options: 峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。
串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.
Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 工作分割與平行效率：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Work partition and parallel efficiency: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對模塊化工作分割提出可反駁的工作分割與平行效率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable work partition and parallel efficiency model and evidence record for modular workload partition.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「工作分割與平行效率」模型，檢查模塊化工作分割的兩個假想案例。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous work partition and parallel efficiency model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving modular workload partition. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.
steps.check: 提交模塊化工作分割的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for modular workload partition.

steps.instructionEn: Identify exaflash/store/tape in the mentor diagram and primary sources for JUPITER modular supercomputing system. Scratch, capacity and archive serve different I/O; checkpoints need write/recovery costs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of storage tiers and checkpoints, focusing on booster, cluster and tiered-storage cooperation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets. stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate sled/host topology and platform interfaces and i/o within the OCP Yosemite V3 modular server case.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對sled與主機拓撲提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for sled/host topology.
steps.instruction: 在「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識sled與主機拓撲。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sled/host topology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for OCP Yosemite V3 modular server. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.

Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. steps.instruction: 在「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多sled工作分割。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets. steps.titleEn: Scheduling, isolation and recovery: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對維護邊界與隔離提出可反駁的排程隔離與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for maintenance boundaries and isolation.
steps.instruction: 在「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識維護邊界與隔離。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify maintenance boundaries and isolation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for OCP Yosemite V3 modular server. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

courses.title: AP1000 壓水式發電架構

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在AP1000 壓水式發電架構案例中比較壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器與汽輪島淨電，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate pwr heat source/steam generators and turbine-island net power within the AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for pwr heat source/steam generators.
steps.instruction: 在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify pwr heat source/steam generators in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for pwr heat source/steam generators.

steps.title: 餘熱與持續冷卻：架構分析

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

courses.summary: 以直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界解析ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture through direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析

Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 模組化與共用系統：架構分析

steps.instruction: 在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識複製與廠址界面。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構案例中比較壓力管與熱傳邊界與蒸汽與汽輪發電，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate pressure-tube heat-transfer boundary and steam/turbine generation within the Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對壓力管與熱傳邊界提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for pressure-tube heat-transfer boundary.
steps.instruction: 在「Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓力管與熱傳邊界。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify pressure-tube heat-transfer boundary in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 模組化與共用系統：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Modularity and shared systems: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對多個模塊共用池提出可反駁的模組化與共用系統模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable modularity and shared systems model and evidence record for shared multimodule pool.
steps.instruction: 在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多個模塊共用池。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify shared multimodule pool in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：模塊數增加就自動消除所有共同故障。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More modules automatically eliminate common failures.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for shared multimodule pool.

courses.summaryEn: Explore NuScale US600 modular design study through integral pwr modules and a shared pool: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for small-bwr steam boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「核島與汽輪機島邊界」模型，檢查小型BWR蒸汽邊界的兩個假想案例。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving small-bwr steam boundaries. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交小型BWR蒸汽邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for small-bwr steam boundaries.

knowledge.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界
knowledge.text: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 本課架構對應：小型BWR蒸汽邊界
knowledge.textEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Course architecture correspondence: Small-BWR steam boundaries

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設民用熱源 700 MWth、熱電效率 0.30、輔機 12 MWe，淨電=700×0.30−12=198.0 MWe；循環排熱約490.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 700 MWth, efficiency 0.30 and auxiliaries 12 MWe: net power 198.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 490.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

quiz.question: 就小型BWR蒸汽邊界的「核島與汽輪機島邊界」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nuclear and turbine-island boundaries in small-bwr steam boundaries?
options: 所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
quiz.explanationEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.

steps.title: 熱循環與淨電效率：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Thermal cycles and net efficiency: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對模塊與汽輪轉換提出可反駁的熱循環與淨電效率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable thermal cycles and net efficiency model and evidence record for module/turbine conversion.
steps.instruction: 在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模塊與汽輪轉換。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify module/turbine conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。
steps.observationEn: Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：熱功率增加量必然等於可送電增加量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Added thermal power necessarily equals added export power.
steps.check: 提交模塊與汽輪轉換的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for module/turbine conversion.

steps.title: 餘熱與持續冷卻：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Residual heat and sustained cooling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對餘熱與熱容量提出可反駁的餘熱與持續冷卻模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual heat and sustained cooling model and evidence record for residual heat/capacity.
steps.instruction: 在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱與熱容量。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify residual heat/capacity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：停止發電後任何排熱需求都立即變成零。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All heat-removal demand immediately vanishes after generation stops.
steps.check: 提交餘熱與熱容量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 被動與主動支援：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Passive and active support: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對自然循環熱路提出可反駁的被動與主動支援模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable passive and active support model and evidence record for natural-circulation heat paths.
steps.instruction: 在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識自然循環熱路。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable modularity and shared systems model and evidence record for shared module infrastructure.
steps.instruction: 在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模塊共用基礎設施。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統案例中比較氦熱路與蒸汽邊界與共用汽輪島，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate helium/steam boundaries and shared turbine island within the HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對氦熱路與蒸汽邊界提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for helium/steam boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識氦熱路與蒸汽邊界。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify helium/steam boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交氦熱路與蒸汽邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for helium/steam boundaries.

steps.title: 餘熱與持續冷卻：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Residual heat and sustained cooling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對餘熱與熱容概念提出可反駁的餘熱與持續冷卻模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual heat and sustained cooling model and evidence record for residual heat/capacitance.
steps.instruction: 在「HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱與熱容概念。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify residual heat/capacitance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：停止發電後任何排熱需求都立即變成零。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All heat-removal demand immediately vanishes after generation stops.
steps.check: 提交餘熱與熱容概念的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for residual heat/capacitance.

knowledge.text: 只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；停止發電後任何排熱需求都立即變成零。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: All heat-removal demand immediately vanishes after generation stops.

quiz.question: 就餘熱與熱容概念的「餘熱與持續冷卻」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for residual heat and sustained cooling in residual heat/capacitance?
options: 停止發電後任何排熱需求都立即變成零。
停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: All heat-removal demand immediately vanishes after generation stops.
Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only.

steps.title: 餘熱與持續冷卻：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual heat and sustained cooling: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對餘熱與熱容概念提出可反駁的餘熱與持續冷卻模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual heat and sustained cooling model and evidence record for residual heat/capacitance.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「餘熱與持續冷卻」模型，檢查餘熱與熱容概念的兩個假想案例。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous residual heat and sustained cooling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving residual heat/capacitance. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：停止發電後任何排熱需求都立即變成零。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All heat-removal demand immediately vanishes after generation stops.
steps.check: 提交餘熱與熱容概念的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for residual heat/capacitance.

steps.title: 被動與主動支援：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Passive and active support: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對傳熱與支持依賴提出可反駁的被動與主動支援模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable passive and active support model and evidence record for heat-transfer/support dependencies.
steps.instruction: 在「HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識傳熱與支持依賴。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify heat-transfer/support dependencies in the mentor diagram and primary sources for HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.

steps.title: 模組化與共用系統：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Modularity and shared systems: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對雙模組接口提出可反駁的模組化與共用系統模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable modularity and shared systems model and evidence record for twin-module interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在「HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識雙模組接口。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify twin-module interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More modules automatically eliminate common failures.

steps.instruction: 在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識tokamak真空與磁場。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

options: 達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.

steps.title: 加熱與能量增益：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Heating and gain: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對plasma與設施Q邊界提出可反駁的加熱與能量增益模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heating and gain model and evidence record for plasma/facility q boundaries.

steps.instructionEn: Identify plasma/facility q boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：Q大於1就保證全廠淨髮電大於0。

steps.title: 加熱與能量增益：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Heating and gain: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對plasma與設施Q邊界提出可反駁的加熱與能量增益模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heating and gain model and evidence record for plasma/facility q boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「加熱與能量增益」模型，檢查plasma與設施Q邊界的兩個假想案例。分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。

Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instruction: 在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識超導coil公差。磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。 建立磁體或光學精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heat exhaust and surface loads model and evidence record for divertor heat loads.
steps.instruction: 在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識divertor熱負載。熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。 建立熱排出與表面負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat exhaust and surface loads, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

courses.summary: 以大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出解析ITER 國際磁約束研究工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering through large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate 3d stellarator confinement and input/plasma energy within the Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對三維stellarator約束提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for 3d stellarator confinement.
steps.instruction: 在「Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識三維stellarator約束。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非平面超導線圈與長脈衝熱管理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify 3d stellarator confinement in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on nonplanar superconducting coils and long-pulse heat management. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
steps.check: 提交三維stellarator約束的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for 3d stellarator confinement.

knowledge.title: 約束方式與系統邊界
knowledge.text: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 本課架構對應：三維stellarator約束
knowledge.textEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Course architecture correspondence: 3D stellarator confinement

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.

quiz.question: 就三維stellarator約束的「約束方式與系統邊界」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for confinement and system boundaries in 3d stellarator confinement?
options: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。
達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant.
A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對三維stellarator約束提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for 3d stellarator confinement.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「約束方式與系統邊界」模型，檢查三維stellarator約束的兩個假想案例。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous confinement and system boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving 3d stellarator confinement. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
steps.check: 提交三維stellarator約束的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for 3d stellarator confinement.

steps.title: 加熱與能量增益：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Heating and gain: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對輸入與plasma熱量提出可反駁的加熱與能量增益模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heating and gain model and evidence record for input/plasma energy.
steps.instruction: 在「Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識輸入與plasma熱量。等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。 建立加熱與能量增益的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非平面超導線圈與長脈衝熱管理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify input/plasma energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on nonplanar superconducting coils and long-pulse heat management. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。
steps.observationEn: Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Q大於1就保證全廠淨髮電大於0。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Q above one guarantees positive plant net electricity.
steps.check: 提交輸入與plasma熱量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 磁體或光學精度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Magnet or optical precision: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對非平面coil幾何提出可反駁的磁體或光學精度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable magnet or optical precision model and evidence record for nonplanar coil geometry.
steps.instruction: 在「Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識非平面coil幾何。磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。 建立磁體或光學精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非平面超導線圈與長脈衝熱管理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on nonplanar superconducting coils and long-pulse heat management. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries. knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。

steps.title: 診斷與控制證據：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對公開diagnostics提出可反駁的診斷與控制證據模型與驗證紀錄。
