steps.instruction: 在「JT-60SA 超導 tokamak」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開diagnostics。診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。 建立診斷與控制證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是超導磁體、低溫屏蔽與支援系統。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；模型輸出都可當成直接無誤差量測。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every modeled value is an error-free direct measurement.

quiz.question: 就公開diagnostics的「診斷與控制證據」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for diagnostics and control evidence in public diagnostics?
options: 模型輸出都可當成直接無誤差量測。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。
optionsEn: Every modeled value is an error-free direct measurement.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information.
quiz.explanation: 診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。 分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。
quiz.explanationEn: Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars.

steps.title: 診斷與控制證據：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Diagnostics and control evidence: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對公開diagnostics提出可反駁的診斷與控制證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable diagnostics and control evidence model and evidence record for public diagnostics.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「診斷與控制證據」模型，檢查公開diagnostics的兩個假想案例。分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous diagnostics and control evidence model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving public diagnostics. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。
steps.observationEn: Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：模型輸出都可當成直接無誤差量測。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every modeled value is an error-free direct measurement.
steps.check: 提交公開diagnostics的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public diagnostics.

steps.title: 研究裝置與電廠差距：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Research-to-power-plant gaps: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對實驗與電廠整合差距提出可反駁的研究裝置與電廠差距模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable research-to-power-plant gaps model and evidence record for experiment/plant integration gaps.
steps.instruction: 在「JT-60SA 超導 tokamak」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識實驗與電廠整合差距。可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 建立研究裝置與電廠差距的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是超導磁體、低溫屏蔽與支援系統。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify experiment/plant integration gaps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for JT-60SA superconducting tokamak. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on superconducting magnets, thermal shielding and support systems. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。
steps.observationEn: List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.
steps.check: 提交實驗與電廠整合差距的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for experiment/plant integration gaps.

courses.summary: 以超導磁體、低溫屏蔽與支援系統解析JT-60SA 超導 tokamak：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore JT-60SA superconducting tokamak through superconducting magnets, thermal shielding and support systems: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
workedExample.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate compact tokamak geometry and projected q/facility boundaries within the SPARC high-field tokamak research case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對緊湊tokamak幾何提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for compact tokamak geometry.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識緊湊tokamak幾何。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify compact tokamak geometry in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for compact tokamak geometry.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「約束方式與系統邊界」模型，檢查緊湊tokamak幾何的兩個假想案例。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous confinement and system boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving compact tokamak geometry. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
steps.check: 提交緊湊tokamak幾何的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for compact tokamak geometry.

knowledge.title: 約束方式與系統邊界
knowledge.text: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 本課架構對應：緊湊tokamak幾何
knowledge.textEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Course architecture correspondence: Compact tokamak geometry

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.

quiz.question: 就緊湊tokamak幾何的「約束方式與系統邊界」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for confinement and system boundaries in compact tokamak geometry?
options: 達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.

steps.title: 加熱與能量增益：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Heating and gain: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對預期Q與設施邊界提出可反駁的加熱與能量增益模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heating and gain model and evidence record for projected q/facility boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識預期Q與設施邊界。等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。 建立加熱與能量增益的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify projected q/facility boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。
steps.observationEn: Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Q大於1就保證全廠淨髮電大於0。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Q above one guarantees positive plant net electricity.
steps.check: 提交預期Q與設施邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for projected q/facility boundaries.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable magnet or optical precision model and evidence record for hts magnet loads.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識HTS磁體負載。磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。 建立磁體或光學精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 熱排出與表面負載：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Heat exhaust and surface loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對緊湊壁面熱通量提出可反駁的熱排出與表面負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heat exhaust and surface loads model and evidence record for compact-device surface flux.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識緊湊壁面熱通量。熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。 建立熱排出與表面負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify compact-device surface flux in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat exhaust and surface loads, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。
steps.observationEn: Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：相同總功率代表所有表面熱通量相同。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal total power means equal surface heat flux everywhere.
steps.check: 提交緊湊壁面熱通量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for compact-device surface flux.

knowledge.title: 熱排出與表面負載
knowledge.text: 熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。 本課架構對應：緊湊壁面熱通量
knowledge.textEn: Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Course architecture correspondence: Compact-device surface flux

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；相同總功率代表所有表面熱通量相同。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Equal total power means equal surface heat flux everywhere.

quiz.question: 就緊湊壁面熱通量的「熱排出與表面負載」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for heat exhaust and surface loads in compact-device surface flux?
options: 熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。
相同總功率代表所有表面熱通量相同。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands.
Equal total power means equal surface heat flux everywhere.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。 由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。
quiz.explanationEn: Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area.

steps.title: 熱排出與表面負載：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Heat exhaust and surface loads: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對緊湊壁面熱通量提出可反駁的熱排出與表面負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heat exhaust and surface loads model and evidence record for compact-device surface flux.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「熱排出與表面負載」模型，檢查緊湊壁面熱通量的兩個假想案例。由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous heat exhaust and surface loads model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving compact-device surface flux. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。
steps.observationEn: Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：相同總功率代表所有表面熱通量相同。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal total power means equal surface heat flux everywhere.
steps.check: 提交緊湊壁面熱通量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for compact-device surface flux.

stages.title: 獨立驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 在SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究案例中比較診斷與仿真驗證與目標與已證明能力，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate diagnostics/simulation validation and goals/demonstrated capabilities within the SPARC high-field tokamak research case.

steps.title: 診斷與控制證據：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Diagnostics and control evidence: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對診斷與仿真驗證提出可反駁的診斷與控制證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable diagnostics and control evidence model and evidence record for diagnostics/simulation validation.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識診斷與仿真驗證。診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。 建立診斷與控制證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify diagnostics/simulation validation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of diagnostics and control evidence, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。
steps.observationEn: Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：模型輸出都可當成直接無誤差量測。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every modeled value is an error-free direct measurement.
steps.check: 提交診斷與仿真驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for diagnostics/simulation validation.

steps.title: 研究裝置與電廠差距：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Research-to-power-plant gaps: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對目標與已證明能力提出可反駁的研究裝置與電廠差距模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable research-to-power-plant gaps model and evidence record for goals/demonstrated capabilities.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識目標與已證明能力。可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 建立研究裝置與電廠差距的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify goals/demonstrated capabilities in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。
steps.observationEn: List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.
steps.check: 提交目標與已證明能力的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for goals/demonstrated capabilities.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對慣性約束系統邊界提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for inertial-confinement boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「NIF 慣性融合能量邊界」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識慣性約束系統邊界。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify inertial-confinement boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.

steps.check: 提交慣性約束系統邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inertial-confinement boundaries.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假想單次脈衝：到target的雷射能量2 MJ、融合輸出3 MJ，Qtarget=1.5。若wall-plug雷射效率2%，電網驅動需100 MJ；僅回收融合熱且熱電效率35%，輸出1.05 MJ；另有5 MJ輔助輸入，淨能量=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ。未回收雷射熱，皆為假想而非NIF實測；target gain不等於電廠淨電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one pulse with laser energy 2 MJ at the target and fusion output 3 MJ: Qtarget=1.5. At assumed wall-plug laser efficiency 2%, driver input is 100 MJ. Recovering only fusion heat at 35% gives 1.05 MJ; auxiliaries consume 5 MJ, so net=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ. Laser-heat recovery is omitted; values are hypothetical, not NIF measurements. Target gain is not plant net electricity.

courses.summary: 以高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量解析NIF 慣性融合能量邊界：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。

steps.instruction: 在「MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識球形tokamak約束。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

courses.summary: 以低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究解析MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore MAST Upgrade spherical tokamak through low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

steps.instruction: 在「DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識研究方案與可用率。可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 建立研究裝置與電廠差距的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable research-to-power-plant gaps model and evidence record for research regimes/availability.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「研究裝置與電廠差距」模型，檢查研究方案與可用率的兩個假想案例。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous research-to-power-plant gaps model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving research regimes/availability. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。
steps.observationEn: List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.
steps.check: 提交研究方案與可用率的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for research regimes/availability.

knowledge.title: 研究裝置與電廠差距
knowledge.text: 可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 本課架構對應：研究方案與可用率
knowledge.textEn: Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Course architecture correspondence: Research regimes/availability

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.

quiz.question: 就研究方案與可用率的「研究裝置與電廠差距」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for research-to-power-plant gaps in research regimes/availability?
options: 單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。
optionsEn: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations.
quiz.explanation: 可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。
quiz.explanationEn: Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations.

courses.summary: 以磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合解析DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore DIII-D configurable tokamak research through magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
workedExample.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「診斷與控制證據」模型，檢查模型與量測分離的兩個假想案例。分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous diagnostics and control evidence model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving models versus measurements. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。
steps.observationEn: Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：模型輸出都可當成直接無誤差量測。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every modeled value is an error-free direct measurement.
steps.check: 提交模型與量測分離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for models versus measurements.

steps.instructionEn: Identify research extrapolation boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

courses.summary: 以球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理解析NSTX-U 球形電漿研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore NSTX-U spherical-plasma research through spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
workedExample.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for 15-mw wind/power envelope.
steps.instruction: 在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識15MW風速功率包絡。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify 15-mw wind/power envelope in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Identify reference-blade aerodynamics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對參考blade氣動提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for reference-blade aerodynamics.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「葉片氣動與載荷」模型，檢查參考blade氣動的兩個假想案例。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。

Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. steps.instruction: 在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識固定浮式support模型。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

courses.summary: 以開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計解析IEA 15 MW 參考風機：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine through open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. steps.instruction: 在「Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識大型blade載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

knowledge.textEn: Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Course architecture correspondence: Array blade loads

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.

quiz.question: 就陣列blade載荷的「葉片氣動與載荷」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for blade aerodynamics and loads in array blade loads?
options: 提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。
optionsEn: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide.
quiz.explanation: 扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
quiz.explanationEn: Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對陣列blade載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for array blade loads.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「葉片氣動與載荷」模型，檢查陣列blade載荷的兩個假想案例。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous blade aerodynamics and loads model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving array blade loads. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交陣列blade載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for array blade loads.

stages.title: 功能架構與量化模型
stages.description: 在霍恩西離岸風電場案例中比較風機與海上集電與基礎與海況模態，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate turbines/offshore collection and foundations/sea-state modes within the Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm case.

steps.title: 傳動與發電轉換：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Drivetrain and electrical conversion: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對風機與海上集電提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable drivetrain and electrical conversion model and evidence record for turbines/offshore collection.
steps.instruction: 在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識風機與海上集電。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify turbines/offshore collection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。
steps.observationEn: Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：直驅代表無需發電機或功率電子。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Direct drive removes generators and power electronics.
steps.check: 提交風機與海上集電的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for turbines/offshore collection.

steps.title: 支撐繫泊與動態：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Supports, mooring and dynamics: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對基礎與海況模態提出可反駁的支撐繫泊與動態模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable supports, mooring and dynamics model and evidence record for foundations/sea-state modes.
steps.instruction: 在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識基礎與海況模態。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify foundations/sea-state modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Floating turbines can ignore waves and moorings.

steps.instructionEn: Identify wakes/export cables in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Identify offshore access windows in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Assume a teaching rotor with rho=1.225 kg/m³, A=110 m², v=8 m/s and Cp=0.40: P=13.7984 kW. Drivetrain/electrical loss, wakes, ratings and wind distributions are excluded; these are not project specifications.

optionsEn: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.
Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

quiz.explanationEn: Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series.

steps.objective: 針對Tampen風資源提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for tampen wind resources.
steps.instruction: 在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Tampen風資源。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify tampen wind resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable supports, mooring and dynamics model and evidence record for mooring/floater modes.
steps.instruction: 在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識繫泊與浮體模態。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mooring/floater modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：浮式風機可忽略波浪與繫泊。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Floating turbines can ignore waves and moorings.
steps.check: 提交繫泊與浮體模態的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mooring/floater modes.

knowledge.title: 支撐繫泊與動態
knowledge.text: 固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 本課架構對應：繫泊與浮體模態
knowledge.textEn: Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Course architecture correspondence: Mooring/floater modes

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；浮式風機可忽略波浪與繫泊。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Floating turbines can ignore waves and moorings.

quiz.question: 就繫泊與浮體模態的「支撐繫泊與動態」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for supports, mooring and dynamics in mooring/floater modes?
options: 固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。
浮式風機可忽略波浪與繫泊。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion.
Floating turbines can ignore waves and moorings.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations.

steps.title: 支撐繫泊與動態：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Supports, mooring and dynamics: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對繫泊與浮體模態提出可反駁的支撐繫泊與動態模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable supports, mooring and dynamics model and evidence record for mooring/floater modes.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「支撐繫泊與動態」模型，檢查繫泊與浮體模態的兩個假想案例。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous supports, mooring and dynamics model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving mooring/floater modes. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：浮式風機可忽略波浪與繫泊。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Floating turbines can ignore waves and moorings.
steps.check: 提交繫泊與浮體模態的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

stages.title: 獨立驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 在Hywind Tampen 浮式風電案例中比較動態海纜與陣列與海況與供電可用率，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate dynamic cables/array and sea states/power availability within the Hywind Tampen floating wind case.

steps.title: 陣列尾流與海纜：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Array wakes and cables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對動態海纜與陣列提出可反駁的陣列尾流與海纜模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable array wakes and cables model and evidence record for dynamic cables/array.
steps.instruction: 在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識動態海纜與陣列。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify dynamic cables/array in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。
steps.observationEn: Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：風場效率就是單機效率與機組數相乘。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Farm efficiency is single-turbine efficiency times turbine count.
steps.check: 提交動態海纜與陣列的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for dynamic cables/array.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for array wakes and cables in dynamic cables/array?
options: 風場效率就是單機效率與機組數相乘。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。
optionsEn: Farm efficiency is single-turbine efficiency times turbine count.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies.
quiz.explanation: 上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。

steps.title: 監測維護與疲勞：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, maintenance and fatigue: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對海況與供電可用率提出可反駁的監測維護與疲勞模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable monitoring, maintenance and fatigue model and evidence record for sea states/power availability.
steps.instruction: 在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海況與供電可用率。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sea states/power availability in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。
steps.observationEn: Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.
steps.check: 提交海況與供電可用率的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sea states/power availability.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for scotland wind distribution.
steps.instruction: 在「海風蘇格蘭浮式風場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Scotland風分佈。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify scotland wind distribution in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。

quiz.question: 就彰化風資源與typhoon的「風資源與功率包絡」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for wind resources and power envelopes in changhua resources/typhoons?
options: 額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對大型rotor與載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Identify large rotors/loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for large rotors/loads.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對大型rotor與載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for large rotors/loads.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「葉片氣動與載荷」模型，檢查大型rotor與載荷的兩個假想案例。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous blade aerodynamics and loads model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving large rotors/loads. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交大型rotor與載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對支撐與海況提出可反駁的支撐繫泊與動態模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable supports, mooring and dynamics model and evidence record for supports/sea states.
steps.instruction: 在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識支撐與海況。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識臺灣O&M與窗口。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對苗栗近岸資源提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for miaoli nearshore resources.
steps.instruction: 在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識苗栗近岸資源。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify miaoli nearshore resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for miaoli nearshore resources.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「風資源與功率包絡」模型，檢查苗栗近岸資源的兩個假想案例。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous wind resources and power envelopes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving miaoli nearshore resources. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. steps.objective: 針對分期電力轉換提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable drivetrain and electrical conversion model and evidence record for phased power conversion.
steps.instruction: 在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識分期電力轉換。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對Hoover有效水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for hoover effective head.
steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hoover有效水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify hoover effective head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交Hoover有效水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hoover effective head.

steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水輪工況map。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.objective: 針對水輪工況map提出可反駁的水輪機與工況模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for turbine operating maps.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「水輪機與工況」模型，檢查水輪工況map的兩個假想案例。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous turbines and operating envelopes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving turbine operating maps. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.
steps.check: 提交水輪工況map的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for turbine operating maps.

knowledge.title: 水輪機與工況
knowledge.text: Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 本課架構對應：水輪工況map
knowledge.textEn: Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Course architecture correspondence: Turbine operating maps

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.

quiz.question: 就水輪工況map的「水輪機與工況」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for turbines and operating envelopes in turbine operating maps?
options: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
quiz.explanationEn: Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.

steps.title: 水路暫態與水錘：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Water transients and water hammer: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對壓力水路暫態提出可反駁的水路暫態與水錘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable water transients and water hammer model and evidence record for penstock transients.
steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓力水路暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify penstock transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。
steps.observationEn: Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：穩態水頭足以排除全部暫態壓力。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Steady head excludes all transient pressure.
steps.check: 提交壓力水路暫態的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for penstock transients.

steps.title: 土建機械與滲流：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Civil works, mechanics and seepage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對厚拱壩載荷路徑提出可反駁的土建機械與滲流模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable civil works, mechanics and seepage model and evidence record for thick-arch load paths.
steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識厚拱壩載荷路徑。壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。 建立土建機械與滲流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify thick-arch load paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。
steps.observationEn: Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：沒有可見漏水就證明基礎與壩體完全健康。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: No visible leakage proves a sound dam/foundation.
steps.check: 提交厚拱壩載荷路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 發電儲能與調度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Generation, storage and scheduling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對供水與發電調度提出可反駁的發電儲能與調度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable generation, storage and scheduling model and evidence record for water/power scheduling.
steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識供水與發電調度。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify water/power scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。
steps.observationEn: Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：抽回同一水就可無輸入重複製造淨能量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Recirculating water creates unlimited net energy without input.
steps.check: 提交供水與發電調度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for water/power scheduling.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable civil works, mechanics and seepage model and evidence record for forebay/dam loads.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「土建機械與滲流」模型，檢查forebay與壩體載荷的兩個假想案例。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous civil works, mechanics and seepage model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving forebay/dam loads. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。
steps.observationEn: Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：沒有可見漏水就證明基礎與壩體完全健康。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: No visible leakage proves a sound dam/foundation.
steps.check: 提交forebay與壩體載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for forebay/dam loads.

quiz.question: 就forebay與壩體載荷的「土建機械與滲流」，哪個推論或驗證成立？

Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate irrigation pump/generation and ecology/sediment metrics within the Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant case.

steps.title: 發電儲能與調度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Generation, storage and scheduling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對灌溉泵發協作提出可反駁的發電儲能與調度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable generation, storage and scheduling model and evidence record for irrigation pump/generation.
steps.instruction: 在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識灌溉泵發協作。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify irrigation pump/generation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。
steps.observationEn: Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：抽回同一水就可無輸入重複製造淨能量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Recirculating water creates unlimited net energy without input.
steps.check: 提交灌溉泵發協作的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for irrigation pump/generation.

steps.title: 泥砂環境與壽命：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Sediment, environment and life: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對生態與泥砂指標提出可反駁的泥砂環境與壽命模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable sediment, environment and life model and evidence record for ecology/sediment metrics.
steps.instruction: 在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識生態與泥砂指標。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify ecology/sediment metrics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sediment, environment and life, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.
steps.check: 提交生態與泥砂指標的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for ecology/sediment metrics.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設淨水頭40 m、流量5 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×5×40×0.88=1.726560 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 40 m, flow 5 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=1.726560 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.
