courses.title: 德基水力發電系統
courses.summary: 以薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量解析德基水力發電系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore Techi Hydropower System through thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在德基水力發電系統案例中比較德基有效水頭與山區水輪工況，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate techi effective head and mountain turbine envelopes within the Techi Hydropower System case.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對德基有效水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for techi effective head.
steps.instruction: 在「德基水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識德基有效水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify techi effective head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Techi Hydropower System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交德基有效水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for techi effective head.

knowledge.title: 水頭流量與能量
knowledge.text: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 本課架構對應：德基有效水頭
knowledge.textEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Course architecture correspondence: Techi effective head

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設淨水頭50 m、流量6 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×6×50×0.88=2.589840 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 50 m, flow 6 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=2.589840 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

quiz.question: 就德基有效水頭的「水頭流量與能量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for head, flow and energy in techi effective head?
options: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。
壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections.
Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對德基有效水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for techi effective head.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「水頭流量與能量」模型，檢查德基有效水頭的兩個假想案例。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous head, flow and energy model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving techi effective head. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交德基有效水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for techi effective head.

steps.title: 水輪機與工況：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Turbines and operating envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對山區水輪工況提出可反駁的水輪機與工況模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for mountain turbine envelopes.
steps.instruction: 在「德基水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識山區水輪工況。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mountain turbine envelopes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Techi Hydropower System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.
steps.check: 提交山區水輪工況的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mountain turbine envelopes.

steps.title: 水路暫態與水錘：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Water transients and water hammer: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對引水隧道暫態提出可反駁的水路暫態與水錘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable water transients and water hammer model and evidence record for headrace transients.
steps.instruction: 在「德基水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識引水隧道暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify headrace transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Techi Hydropower System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。
steps.observationEn: Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：穩態水頭足以排除全部暫態壓力。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Steady head excludes all transient pressure.
steps.check: 提交引水隧道暫態的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.objective: 針對泥砂與集水區提出可反駁的泥砂環境與壽命模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable sediment, environment and life model and evidence record for sediment/catchment.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「泥砂環境與壽命」模型，檢查泥砂與集水區的兩個假想案例。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous sediment, environment and life model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving sediment/catchment. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.
steps.check: 提交泥砂與集水區的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sediment/catchment.

knowledge.title: 泥砂環境與壽命
knowledge.text: 泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 本課架構對應：泥砂與集水區
knowledge.textEn: Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Course architecture correspondence: Sediment/catchment

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設淨水頭50 m、流量6 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×6×50×0.88=2.589840 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 50 m, flow 6 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=2.589840 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

quiz.question: 就泥砂與集水區的「泥砂環境與壽命」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for sediment, environment and life in sediment/catchment?
options: 高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。
optionsEn: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics.
quiz.explanation: 泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。
quiz.explanationEn: Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics.

courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

courses.title: 明潭抽蓄水力發電廠
courses.summary: 以上下池、可逆機組與往返效率解析明潭抽蓄水力發電廠：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant through upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在明潭抽蓄水力發電廠案例中比較上下池淨水頭與可逆水輪pump，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate pool net head and reversible turbine/pump within the Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant case.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對上下池淨水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for pool net head.
steps.instruction: 在「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識上下池淨水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是上下池、可逆機組與往返效率。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify pool net head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交上下池淨水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for pool net head.

steps.title: 水輪機與工況：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Turbines and operating envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對可逆水輪pump提出可反駁的水輪機與工況模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for reversible turbine/pump.
steps.instruction: 在「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識可逆水輪pump。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是上下池、可逆機組與往返效率。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify reversible turbine/pump in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.
steps.check: 提交可逆水輪pump的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reversible turbine/pump.

steps.title: 泥砂環境與壽命：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Sediment, environment and life: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對水位與環境監測提出可反駁的泥砂環境與壽命模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable sediment, environment and life model and evidence record for level/environment monitoring.
steps.instruction: 在「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水位與環境監測。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是上下池、可逆機組與往返效率。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for level/environment monitoring.

steps.instruction: 在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識長江flow與head。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify yangtze flow/head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for large-turbine envelopes.
steps.instruction: 在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識巨型水輪工況。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify large-turbine envelopes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。

steps.objective: 針對水道與機組暫態提出可反駁的水路暫態與水錘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable water transients and water hammer model and evidence record for waterway/unit transients.
steps.instruction: 在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水道與機組暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify waterway/unit transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。

knowledge.textEn: Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Course architecture correspondence: Water/sediment/ecology

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設淨水頭40 m、流量6 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×6×40×0.88=2.071872 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 40 m, flow 6 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=2.071872 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

quiz.question: 就水沙與生態證據的「泥砂環境與壽命」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for sediment, environment and life in water/sediment/ecology?
options: 高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。
optionsEn: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics.

quiz.explanationEn: Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics.

courses.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

courses.title: Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究案例中比較EGS熱與連通與研究井完整性，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate egs heat/connectivity and research-well integrity within the Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research case.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對EGS熱與連通提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for egs heat/connectivity.
steps.instruction: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EGS熱與連通。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify egs heat/connectivity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交EGS熱與連通的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for egs heat/connectivity.

knowledge.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量
knowledge.text: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 本課架構對應：EGS熱與連通
knowledge.textEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Course architecture correspondence: EGS heat/connectivity

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設流體18 kg/s、比焓降290 kJ/kg，熱量率=5220 kW；轉換效率0.12、輔機100 kW，淨電=526.4 kW。未含儲層可持續性、相變細節與回注冷卻，非鑽井或現場設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume flow 18 kg/s and enthalpy drop 290 kJ/kg: heat rate 5220 kW. At conversion 0.12 and auxiliaries 100 kW, net=526.4 kW. Reservoir sustainability, phase details and reinjection cooling are omitted; no field settings are given.

quiz.question: 就EGS熱與連通的「儲層概念與可觀測量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir concepts and observables in egs heat/connectivity?
options: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。
測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation.
A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
quiz.explanationEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對EGS熱與連通提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for egs heat/connectivity.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查EGS熱與連通的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving egs heat/connectivity. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交EGS熱與連通的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for egs heat/connectivity.

steps.title: 井筒完整性與熱損：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Well integrity and heat loss: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對研究井完整性提出可反駁的井筒完整性與熱損模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well integrity and heat loss model and evidence record for research-well integrity.
steps.instruction: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識研究井完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify research-well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.
steps.check: 提交研究井完整性的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for research-well integrity.

steps.instruction: 在「Þeistareykir 地熱工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Theistareykir熱源。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify theistareykir heat source in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Theistareykir geothermal engineering. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.

Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Theistareykir熱源提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for theistareykir heat source.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查Theistareykir熱源的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving theistareykir heat source. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

courses.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. steps.instruction: 在「懷拉基地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識回注與長期溫度。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 在「懷拉基地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識更新環境與階段證據。地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。 建立微震監測與生態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.title: 多相輸送與壓降：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對油氣水多相界面提出可反駁的多相輸送與壓降模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable multiphase transport and pressure drop model and evidence record for oil/gas/water interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識油氣水多相界面。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify oil/gas/water interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield. Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。
steps.observationEn: Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Oil/gas/water mixtures are indistinguishable from pure water without qualification.
steps.check: 提交油氣水多相界面的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海底tieback與平臺。立管、海底設備與上部處理各有壓力、運動及可維修邊界。 建立海底連接與平臺的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫平臺—海底接口並標海況及維護假設。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify subsea tiebacks/platforms in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of subsea links and platforms, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, shutdown and recovery, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

courses.summaryEn: Explore Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield through shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 公開資源工程的離線質量、能量及環境證據判讀；不提供鑽井、井控、採掘、爆破或危險化學浸出SOP。採礦權、許可、地質完整性與現場規範需由合格團隊另行確認，課程完成不是操作資格。
courses.scopeEn: Offline public resource-engineering material/energy/environmental analysis; no drilling, well-control, excavation, blasting or hazardous-leaching SOP. Qualified teams separately establish rights, permits, integrity and field requirements; completion is not operating qualification.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate deepwater-reservoir hypotheses and well/pressure containment within the Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring case.

steps.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir models and material balance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對深水reservoir假說提出可反駁的儲層模型與物料平衡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir models and material balance model and evidence record for deepwater-reservoir hypotheses.
steps.instruction: 在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識深水reservoir假說。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify deepwater-reservoir hypotheses in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。
steps.observationEn: Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.
steps.check: 提交深水reservoir假說的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for deepwater-reservoir hypotheses.

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well barriers and integrity, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海底多相pump。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable monitoring, shutdown and recovery model and evidence record for ai diagnosis/independent evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識AI診斷與獨立證據。可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。 建立監測停機與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify ai diagnosis/independent evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, shutdown and recovery, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對氣體與液化相態提出可反駁的多相輸送與壓降模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable multiphase transport and pressure drop model and evidence record for gas/liquefaction phases.
steps.instruction: 在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識氣體與液化相態。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gas/liquefaction phases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。
steps.observationEn: Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Oil/gas/water mixtures are indistinguishable from pure water without qualification.
steps.check: 提交氣體與液化相態的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gas/liquefaction phases.

options: 油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。

Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 多相輸送與壓降：證據驗證

steps.objective: 針對氣體與液化相態提出可反駁的多相輸送與壓降模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous multiphase transport and pressure drop model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving gas/liquefaction phases. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.title: 海底連接與平臺：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Subsea links and platforms: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對浮式平臺與transfer提出可反駁的海底連接與平臺模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable subsea links and platforms model and evidence record for floating-platform transfer.
steps.instruction: 在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識浮式平臺與transfer。立管、海底設備與上部處理各有壓力、運動及可維修邊界。 建立海底連接與平臺的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫平臺—海底接口並標海況及維護假設。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify floating-platform transfer in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Risers, subsea systems and topsides have distinct pressure, motion and serviceability boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of subsea links and platforms, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：平臺穩定證明海底所有部件沒有動態負載。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Platform stability proves no dynamic load on subsea components.

steps.title: 處理能量與排放：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Processing energy and emissions: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對冷卻能耗與邊界提出可反駁的處理能量與排放模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable processing energy and emissions model and evidence record for cooling energy/boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識冷卻能耗與邊界。分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。 建立處理能量與排放的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify cooling energy/boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of processing energy and emissions, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

options: 分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。
岸電必然等於整個油氣產品零排放。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions.
Shore power means zero lifecycle emissions for oil/gas products.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。 分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。
quiz.explanationEn: Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero. Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions.

steps.title: 監測停機與復原：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, shutdown and recovery: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對可用率與事件證據提出可反駁的監測停機與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable monitoring, shutdown and recovery model and evidence record for availability/event evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識可用率與事件證據。可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。 建立監測停機與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify availability/event evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, shutdown and recovery, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。
steps.observationEn: Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：恢復產量本身就證明所有安全狀態均正確。

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for availability/event evidence.

courses.summary: 以海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界解析Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。

steps.instruction: 在「Troll 海上油氣平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識氣體compression界面。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on gravity bases, shore power and compression support. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable subsea links and platforms model and evidence record for condeep/piping.

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of subsea links and platforms, focusing on gravity bases, shore power and compression support. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Sleipner 油氣與碳封存案例中比較油氣與CO2物料與井筒完整性概念，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate hydrocarbon/co2 balance and well-integrity concepts within the Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage case.

steps.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir models and material balance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對油氣與CO2物料提出可反駁的儲層模型與物料平衡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir models and material balance model and evidence record for hydrocarbon/co2 balance.
steps.instruction: 在「Sleipner 油氣與碳封存」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識油氣與CO2物料。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify hydrocarbon/co2 balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。
steps.observationEn: Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對金銅grade分佈提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識金銅grade分佈。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gold/copper grades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gold/copper grades.

knowledge.textEn: Assume dry feed 900 t, grade 1.6 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1224.0 g=1.2240 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.

steps.title: 粒徑解離與破碎：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Particle size, liberation and comminution: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對粒度與解離提出可反駁的粒徑解離與破碎模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable particle size, liberation and comminution model and evidence record for size/liberation.
steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識粒度與解離。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify size/liberation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：研磨越細就必然提升全部經濟與環境指標。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer grinding improves every economic/environmental metric.
steps.check: 提交粒度與解離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for size/liberation.

knowledge.title: 粒徑解離與破碎
knowledge.text: 粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 本課架構對應：粒度與解離
knowledge.textEn: Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Course architecture correspondence: Size/liberation

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；研磨越細就必然提升全部經濟與環境指標。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Finer grinding improves every economic/environmental metric.

quiz.question: 就粒度與解離的「粒徑解離與破碎」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for particle size, liberation and comminution in size/liberation?
options: 研磨越細就必然提升全部經濟與環境指標。
粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Finer grinding improves every economic/environmental metric.
Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。
quiz.explanationEn: Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy.

steps.title: 粒徑解離與破碎：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Particle size, liberation and comminution: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對粒度與解離提出可反駁的粒徑解離與破碎模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable particle size, liberation and comminution model and evidence record for size/liberation.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「粒徑解離與破碎」模型，檢查粒度與解離的兩個假想案例。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous particle size, liberation and comminution model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving size/liberation. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：研磨越細就必然提升全部經濟與環境指標。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer grinding improves every economic/environmental metric.
steps.check: 提交粒度與解離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for size/liberation.

steps.title: 重力選別與質量收支：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Gravity separation and mass balance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對給料與精礦balance提出可反駁的重力選別與質量收支模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gravity separation and mass balance model and evidence record for feed/concentrate balance.

steps.instructionEn: Identify feed/concentrate balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Density, size and shape affect gravity separation; concentrate grade, yield and recovery differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gravity separation and mass balance, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check metal balance from assumed feed/concentrate data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.observationEn: Check metal balance from assumed feed/concentrate data.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：精礦品位越高就保證回收金屬越多。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Higher concentrate grade guarantees more metal recovered.
steps.check: 提交給料與精礦balance的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate communications/people separation and mine water/tailings/rehabilitation within the Boddington automated gold/copper mine case.

steps.title: 通風電力與自動化：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Ventilation, power and automation: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對通信與人員隔離提出可反駁的通風電力與自動化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ventilation, power and automation model and evidence record for communications/people separation.
steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識通信與人員隔離。地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。 建立通風電力與自動化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify communications/people separation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ventilation, power and automation, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：自動化設備無需人員與道路隔離設計。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Automated equipment needs no people/route separation design.
steps.check: 提交通信與人員隔離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 尾礦水與復育：架構分析

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable tailings, water and rehabilitation model and evidence record for mine water/tailings/rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識礦水尾礦與覆育。尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 建立尾礦水與復育的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.objective: 針對地下ventilation供電提出可反駁的通風電力與自動化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ventilation, power and automation model and evidence record for underground ventilation/power.
steps.instruction: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識地下ventilation供電。地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。 建立通風電力與自動化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify underground ventilation/power in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ventilation, power and automation, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。
steps.observationEn: Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：自動化設備無需人員與道路隔離設計。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Automated equipment needs no people/route separation design.
steps.check: 提交地下ventilation供電的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for underground ventilation/power.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「通風電力與自動化」模型，檢查地下ventilation供電的兩個假想案例。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous ventilation, power and automation model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving underground ventilation/power. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.title: 尾礦水與復育：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Tailings, water and rehabilitation: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對尾礦與長期水管理提出可反駁的尾礦水與復育模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable tailings, water and rehabilitation model and evidence record for tailings/long-term water.
steps.instruction: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識尾礦與長期水管理。尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 建立尾礦水與復育的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify tailings/long-term water in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of tailings, water and rehabilitation, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.

knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設乾給料1000 t、品位1.7 g/t、金屬回收率0.85，可回收金屬=1445.0 g=1.4450 kg。回收率不同於精礦品位；未含礦物解離、處理成本或任何浸出配方，非礦場實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume dry feed 1000 t, grade 1.7 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1445.0 g=1.4450 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.

Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

courses.summary: 以panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水解析Cadia 地下金銅礦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore Cadia underground gold/copper mine through panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 公開資源工程的離線質量、能量及環境證據判讀；不提供鑽井、井控、採掘、爆破或危險化學浸出SOP。採礦權、許可、地質完整性與現場規範需由合格團隊另行確認，課程完成不是操作資格。
courses.scopeEn: Offline public resource-engineering material/energy/environmental analysis; no drilling, well-control, excavation, blasting or hazardous-leaching SOP. Qualified teams separately establish rights, permits, integrity and field requirements; completion is not operating qualification.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate kibali resource grades and surface/underground paths within the Kibali large gold-mining engineering case.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Kibali資源grade提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for kibali resource grades.
steps.instruction: 在「Kibali 大型金礦工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Kibali資源grade。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多路徑採礦、支援電力與回收證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify kibali resource grades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Kibali large gold-mining engineering. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on multiple mining routes, support power and recovery evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交Kibali資源grade的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for kibali resource grades.

knowledge.textEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Course architecture correspondence: Kibali resource grades

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設乾給料1100 t、品位1.5 g/t、金屬回收率0.85，可回收金屬=1402.5 g=1.4025 kg。回收率不同於精礦品位；未含礦物解離、處理成本或任何浸出配方，非礦場實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume dry feed 1100 t, grade 1.5 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1402.5 g=1.4025 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.

quiz.question: 就Kibali資源grade的「資源品位與代表採樣」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for resources, grade and representative sampling in kibali resource grades?
options: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。
最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate.
The best sample represents every ore parcel.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
quiz.explanationEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Kibali資源grade提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for kibali resource grades.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「資源品位與代表採樣」模型，檢查Kibali資源grade的兩個假想案例。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous resources, grade and representative sampling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving kibali resource grades. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交Kibali資源grade的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for kibali resource grades.

steps.title: 開坑地下與搬運：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Open-pit, underground and haulage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對露天地下path區別提出可反駁的開坑地下與搬運模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable open-pit, underground and haulage model and evidence record for surface/underground paths.

steps.instructionEn: Identify surface/underground paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Kibali large gold-mining engineering. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on multiple mining routes, support power and recovery evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：露天與地下可沿用所有支護和搬運參數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Surface and underground systems share every support/haulage parameter.
steps.check: 提交露天地下path區別的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for surface/underground paths.

steps.title: 粒徑解離與破碎：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Particle size, liberation and comminution: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對碎磨與能量提出可反駁的粒徑解離與破碎模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable particle size, liberation and comminution model and evidence record for comminution/energy.
steps.instruction: 在「Kibali 大型金礦工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識碎磨與能量。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多路徑採礦、支援電力與回收證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify comminution/energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Kibali large gold-mining engineering. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on multiple mining routes, support power and recovery evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：研磨越細就必然提升全部經濟與環境指標。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer grinding improves every economic/environmental metric.
steps.check: 提交碎磨與能量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gravity separation and mass balance model and evidence record for gold recovery/yield.
steps.instruction: 在「Kibali 大型金礦工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識金回收與產率。密度、粒徑及形狀共同影響重力分離；精礦品位、產率與回收率不同。 建立重力選別與質量收支的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多路徑採礦、支援電力與回收證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用給定假想給料與精礦計算金屬守恆。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 在「Kibali 大型金礦工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識尾礦水與生命週期。尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 建立尾礦水與復育的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多路徑採礦、支援電力與回收證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate placer grades/sampling and permitted regions/handling within the Nome Creek placer gold and gravity separation case.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對砂金grade與取樣提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Identify placer grades/sampling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nome Creek placer gold and gravity separation. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on density separation, representative samples and river environments. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交砂金grade與取樣的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for placer grades/sampling.

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous resources, grade and representative sampling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving placer grades/sampling. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.

steps.instruction: 在「Nome Creek 砂金與重力選別」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識允許區域與搬運。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是密度分離、代表取樣與河川環境。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on density separation, representative samples and river environments. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. steps.title: 粒徑解離與破碎：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Particle size, liberation and comminution: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對粒徑與形狀提出可反駁的粒徑解離與破碎模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable particle size, liberation and comminution model and evidence record for size/shape.
steps.instruction: 在「Nome Creek 砂金與重力選別」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識粒徑與形狀。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是密度分離、代表取樣與河川環境。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify size/shape in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nome Creek placer gold and gravity separation. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on density separation, representative samples and river environments. steps.title: 全連接層與參數：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對MLP weight與bias提出可反駁的全連接層與參數模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable dense layers and parameters model and evidence record for mlp weights/biases.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MLP weight與bias。單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。 建立全連接層與參數的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mlp weights/biases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dense layers and parameters, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.observationEn: Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一層參數數永遠只等於神經元數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Layer parameters always equal neuron count.
steps.check: 提交MLP weight與bias的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設MLP架構32→8→32，每層含bias：encoder有32×8+8=264參數，decoder有8×32+32=288，總552。線性瓶頸最多秩8；非線性增加表達能力但不保證泛化，重建loss不能代替任務驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Assume MLP 32→8→32 with bias: encoder 264 parameters, decoder 288, total 552. A linear bottleneck has rank at most 8; nonlinear expression does not guarantee generalization, and reconstruction loss does not replace task validation.

steps.title: 線性瓶頸與非線性：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對非線性與latent瓶頸提出可反駁的線性瓶頸與非線性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities model and evidence record for nonlinearity/latent bottleneck.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識非線性與latent瓶頸。線性encoder-decoder組合的秩受瓶頸限制；非線性改變表達但不保證保留任務資訊。 建立線性瓶頸與非線性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

A linear encoder-decoder has bottleneck-limited rank; nonlinearity changes expression without ensuring task information survives. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. steps.objective: 針對樣本與重建切分提出可反駁的資料切分與洩漏模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable data splits and leakage model and evidence record for sample/reconstruction splits.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識樣本與重建切分。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sample/reconstruction splits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測試資料參加調參仍可當獨立測試。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.
steps.check: 提交樣本與重建切分的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sample/reconstruction splits.

optionsEn: Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 資料切分與洩漏：證據驗證

steps.objective: 針對樣本與重建切分提出可反駁的資料切分與洩漏模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「資料切分與洩漏」模型，檢查樣本與重建切分的兩個假想案例。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous data splits and leakage model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving sample/reconstruction splits. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instructionEn: Identify latent dimensions/failure in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
