knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設MLP架構32→8→32，每層含bias：encoder有32×8+8=264參數，decoder有8×32+32=288，總552。線性瓶頸最多秩8；非線性增加表達能力但不保證泛化，重建loss不能代替任務驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Assume MLP 32→8→32 with bias: encoder 264 parameters, decoder 288, total 552. A linear bottleneck has rank at most 8; nonlinear expression does not guarantee generalization, and reconstruction loss does not replace task validation.

courses.summary: 以全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建解析深度 MLP 與自動編碼器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore Deep MLP and autoencoder through dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
courses.scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設MLP架構32→8→32，每層含bias：encoder有32×8+8=264參數，decoder有8×32+32=288，總552。線性瓶頸最多秩8；非線性增加表達能力但不保證泛化，重建loss不能代替任務驗證。
workedExample.textEn: Assume MLP 32→8→32 with bias: encoder 264 parameters, decoder 288, total 552. A linear bottleneck has rank at most 8; nonlinear expression does not guarantee generalization, and reconstruction loss does not replace task validation.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

courses.title: LSTM 循環時序網路

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在LSTM 循環時序網路案例中比較input與hidden state與input forget output gates，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate input/hidden states and input/forget/output gates within the LSTM recurrent sequence network case.

steps.title: 記憶與三個閘：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Memory and three gates: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對input與hidden state提出可反駁的記憶與三個閘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable memory and three gates model and evidence record for input/hidden states.
steps.instruction: 在「LSTM 循環時序網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識input與hidden state。常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。 建立記憶與三個閘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify input/hidden states in the mentor diagram and primary sources for LSTM recurrent sequence network. Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of memory and three gates, focusing on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Cell and hidden states are interchangeable in every equation.
steps.check: 提交input與hidden state的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for input/hidden states.

knowledge.title: 記憶與三個閘
knowledge.text: 常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。 本課架構對應：input與hidden state
knowledge.textEn: Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ. Course architecture correspondence: Input/hidden states

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Cell and hidden states are interchangeable in every equation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設帶bias的標準四組LSTM矩陣，輸入d=6、hidden h=10，參數=4h(d+h+1)=680。若簡化記憶路徑forget固定0.95且忽略其他項，20步導數因子0.95²⁰≈0.358486；不是完整LSTM梯度或產品表現。
knowledge.textEn: Assume four standard biased LSTM matrices with input d=6 and hidden h=10: 4h(d+h+1)=680 parameters. On a simplified memory path with fixed forget=0.95 and other terms omitted, a 20-step derivative factor is 0.358486, not the full LSTM gradient/performance.

quiz.question: 就input與hidden state的「記憶與三個閘」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for memory and three gates in input/hidden states?
options: 常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。
cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。

knowledge.textEn: Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Course architecture correspondence: Unrolling/shared parameters

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；只用參數數即可完整預測執行速度。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Parameter count completely predicts runtime.

quiz.question: 就時間展開與共享參數的「運算量與記憶體」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for compute and memory in unrolling/shared parameters?
options: 參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。
只用參數數即可完整預測執行速度。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute.
Parameter count completely predicts runtime.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。
quiz.explanationEn: Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately.

steps.title: 運算量與記憶體：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Compute and memory: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對時間展開與共享參數提出可反駁的運算量與記憶體模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable compute and memory model and evidence record for unrolling/shared parameters.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「運算量與記憶體」模型，檢查時間展開與共享參數的兩個假想案例。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous compute and memory model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving unrolling/shared parameters. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。
steps.observationEn: Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只用參數數即可完整預測執行速度。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Parameter count completely predicts runtime.
steps.check: 提交時間展開與共享參數的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for unrolling/shared parameters.

steps.title: 資料切分與洩漏：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Data splits and leakage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對時間切分與lookahead提出可反駁的資料切分與洩漏模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable data splits and leakage model and evidence record for temporal splits/lookahead.
steps.instruction: 在「LSTM 循環時序網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識時間切分與lookahead。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify temporal splits/lookahead in the mentor diagram and primary sources for LSTM recurrent sequence network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測試資料參加調參仍可當獨立測試。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.
steps.check: 提交時間切分與lookahead的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for temporal splits/lookahead.

steps.title: 失效分析與泛化：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Failure analysis and generalization: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對long-horizon失效提出可反駁的失效分析與泛化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for long-horizon failures.
steps.instruction: 在「LSTM 循環時序網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識long-horizon失效。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify long-horizon failures in the mentor diagram and primary sources for LSTM recurrent sequence network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設帶bias的標準四組LSTM矩陣，輸入d=6、hidden h=10，參數=4h(d+h+1)=680。若簡化記憶路徑forget固定0.95且忽略其他項，20步導數因子0.95²⁰≈0.358486；不是完整LSTM梯度或產品表現。
knowledge.textEn: Assume four standard biased LSTM matrices with input d=6 and hidden h=10: 4h(d+h+1)=680 parameters. On a simplified memory path with fixed forget=0.95 and other terms omitted, a 20-step derivative factor is 0.358486, not the full LSTM gradient/performance.

courses.summary: 以閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度解析LSTM 循環時序網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
courses.summaryEn: Explore LSTM recurrent sequence network through gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
courses.scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
courses.scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界

courses.title: DDPM 擴散生成網路

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在DDPM 擴散生成網路案例中比較clean sample與noise與time-conditioned U-Net，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate clean samples/noise and time-conditioned u-net within the DDPM diffusion-generation network case.

steps.title: 前向加噪與邊際：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Forward noising and marginals: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對clean sample與noise提出可反駁的前向加噪與邊際模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable forward noising and marginals model and evidence record for clean samples/noise.
steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識clean sample與noise。DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。 建立前向加噪與邊際的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify clean samples/noise in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of forward noising and marginals, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。
steps.observationEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.
steps.check: 提交clean sample與noise的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for clean samples/noise.

knowledge.title: 前向加噪與邊際

knowledge.textEn: DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale. Course architecture correspondence: Clean samples/noise

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設q(x_t|x_0)中ᾱ_t=0.81，x_0=2、ε=−1，x_t=√0.81×2+√0.19×(−1)=1.364110。這是單一前向加噪例；noise prediction loss與反向生成品質不同，非特定模型權重結果。
knowledge.textEn: Assume alpha_bar=0.81, x0=2 and epsilon=−1: xt=sqrt(0.81)*2−sqrt(0.19)=1.364110. This is one forward-noising example; noise loss differs from reverse-generation quality and is not an output from model weights.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for forward noising and marginals in clean samples/noise?
options: DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。
每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale.
Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 前向加噪與邊際：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Forward noising and marginals: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對clean sample與noise提出可反駁的前向加噪與邊際模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable forward noising and marginals model and evidence record for clean samples/noise.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「前向加噪與邊際」模型，檢查clean sample與noise的兩個假想案例。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous forward noising and marginals model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving clean samples/noise. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.
steps.check: 提交clean sample與noise的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for clean samples/noise.

steps.title: 時間條件噪聲預測：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Time-conditioned noise prediction: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對time-conditioned U-Net提出可反駁的時間條件噪聲預測模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable time-conditioned noise prediction model and evidence record for time-conditioned u-net.
steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識time-conditioned U-Net。去噪網路需知道噪聲等級；噪聲預測loss与生成分布品質不是同一指標。 建立時間條件噪聲預測的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify time-conditioned u-net in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Denoisers need noise-level conditions; noise-prediction loss differs from generated-distribution quality. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of time-conditioned noise prediction, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。
steps.observationEn: Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：去掉時間條件不會影響任何去噪任務。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Removing time conditioning affects no denoising task.
steps.check: 提交time-conditioned U-Net的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for time-conditioned u-net.

steps.objective: 針對noise prediction gradient提出可反駁的反向取樣與可重現性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reverse sampling and reproducibility model and evidence record for noise-prediction gradients.
steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識noise prediction gradient。反向生成是多步模型依赖過程；seed、排程與模型版本共同决定可重現邊界。 建立反向取樣與可重現性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。保存假想seed、時間序列與版本，分開比較單步誤差及最終品質。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Reverse generation is a multistep model-dependent process; seeds, schedules and versions bound reproducibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record assumed seeds, schedules and versions; separate single-step errors from final quality. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 失效分析與泛化：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Failure analysis and generalization: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對生成品質與失效提出可反駁的失效分析與泛化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for generation quality/failures.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「失效分析與泛化」模型，檢查生成品質與失效的兩個假想案例。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous failure analysis and generalization model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving generation quality/failures. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.
steps.check: 提交生成品質與失效的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for generation quality/failures.

related.title: Google Willow 表面碼系統
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制；Google Willow 表面碼系統改以碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control; Google Willow surface-code system centers on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照transmon 能階與Willow 非諧能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google Willow 表面碼系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以邏輯錯誤證據為起點，設計一項能區分「可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制」與「碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare transmon levels with willow anharmonic levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google Willow surface-code system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from logical-error evidence and propose an observation distinguishing tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control from code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, including uncertainty.
